# Hitech Furniture & Interiors

> Furniture showroom, custom furniture maker, wholesaler and interior designer in Kalpetta, Wayanad, Kerala. 14+ years in business. Furniture for every budget - premium, mid-range and low budget. Delivers across Wayanad, Malabar, Kerala, Bengaluru and Tamil Nadu.

## Products
- Sofas, sofa-cum-beds, recliners
- Beds, cots, bedroom sets, wardrobes
- Dining tables and dining sets
- Mattresses: Kurlon, Repose, Peps, Modo and local makes
- Office furniture, chairs, tables, TV units, console tables
- Custom-made wooden furniture made to order
- Complete home and shop interiors (modular kitchen, wardrobes, interior works)

## Services
- Retail and wholesale furniture
- Made-to-order custom furniture
- Interior design and execution
- Home delivery across Wayanad, Malabar, Kerala, Bengaluru and Tamil Nadu
- Warranty on wooden furniture (keep the bill)
